2607.07766.title: Alignment Plausibility: A New Standard for Assuring AI in Healthcare
2607.07766.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become significant providers of mental health support, yet they remain products of an attention economy whose operational and commercial targets favour sustained engagement over the friction that effective psychological support often requires. Developers' safety responses have been largely reactive, addressing the most visible and acute harms while subtler, longer-term patterns of risk (e.g., dependency, boundary erosion, the amplification of distorted beliefs) receive less attention. We contend that making LLMs structurally safe requires alignment organised at three levels that mirror how society assures the safety of human clinical practice: 1) explicit value specification grounded in the codified normative commitments of clinical practice; 2) training that embeds those values in the model; and 3) oversight that detects drift and longer-term harm during deployment, much as clinical supervision does for human practice. Organising alignment in this way yields a construct we call alignment plausibility - a structured demonstration that a system's values, training regime, and oversight mechanisms are together consistent with safe and positive outcomes. We propose alignment plausibility as a regulatory construct (by drawing analogy to the established construct of biological plausibility) for AI in health: a principled way to argue for, or against, trust that systems are aligned to positive health outcomes, will cause no harm even where capable of doing so, and will ultimately lead to patient benefit.
2607.07766.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）已成為心理健康支持的重要提供者，然而它們仍然是注意力經濟的產物，其運作和商業目標更偏向於持續的參與，而非有效心理支持所需的摩擦。開發者的安全反應主要是反應性的，針對最明顯和急迫的危害進行處理，而較微妙的、長期的風險模式（例如，依賴性、邊界侵蝕、扭曲信念的放大）則受到的關注較少。我們認為，讓LLMs在結構上安全需要在三個層面上進行對齊，這些層面反映了社會如何確保人類臨床實踐的安全：1）基於臨床實踐的編碼規範承諾的明確價值規範；2）將這些價值嵌入模型的訓練；3）在部署過程中檢測偏離和長期危害的監督，這與人類實踐的臨床監督類似。以這種方式組織對齊產生了一個我們稱之為對齊合理性的構念——一種結構化的證明，表明系統的價值觀、訓練制度和監督機制共同與安全和積極的結果一致。我們提出對齊合理性作為健康領域AI的一個監管構念（通過類比於已建立的生物合理性構念）：一種原則性的方式來論證系統是否與積極的健康結果對齊，即使在有能力造成傷害的情況下也不會造成傷害，並最終導致患者受益。
